name: Batuhan Yumurtacı

education.notes: Elite Istanbul lycée. Moved to Germany for university.
Undergraduate at TUM with an exchange program in South Korea during the degree.
Master's degree in robotics and AI; thesis on autonomous drones and computer vision at Imperial College London.

keyDecisions: Took internships at Airbus and MAN during his Munich TU degree — aerospace and heavy-industry exposure inside the German engineering ecosystem.
Used the TUM degree as a launchpad into Europe's defence-tech / aerospace cluster early, rather than going software-first.
lessons: Defence/aerospace internships in your undergrad set you up for deep-tech founding in ways pure-software internships don't.
Geographic relocation (Turkey → Germany at 18) is a high-leverage option when your home market is weaker for your target vertical.
careerSteps.notes: Per Anadolu Agency / Avrupa Olay coverage.

keyDecisions: Co-founded TYTAN Technologies in Munich in 2023 with Balazs Nagy (CEO) — defence-tech focus on autonomous interception systems against modern UAV threats.
Picked autonomous drones / counter-UAV — the exact intersection of his TUM mechanical + Imperial robotics/AI training.
Raised a €30M Series A — substantial round for a defence-tech company in Germany.
Built a 'bullet aerial vehicle' reaching 250 km/h to neutralise enemy drones — bet on speed-of-intercept as the defensible moat.
lessons: Defence-tech is one of the few European deep-tech verticals where the buyer (NATO governments) has both budget and urgency post-2022 — a structural tailwind founders can ride.
Turkey → Germany → UK → Germany is a viable European mobility pattern for deep-tech founders chasing the best engineering education and the best venture market for the vertical.
Wartime-relevant defence-tech is one of the few sectors where a 25-year-old co-founder can credibly raise a €30M Series A on technical merit alone.
Pair a Mech + AI cross-trained CTO with a commercial CEO — the founder mix that defence procurement teams trust.
careerSteps.notes: Founded 2023 in Munich. Per Forbes 30 Under 30 Europe 2026 AI and Anadolu coverage. €30M Series A 2026.

outcomes.currentStatus: Co-Founder & CTO of TYTAN Technologies (Munich). €30M Series A defence-tech company building autonomous counter-UAV systems.

lessons.lesson: Defence-tech is a structurally-tailwinded European deep-tech category post-2022 — NATO budgets + urgency align with founder velocity.
Mechanical Eng undergrad + Robotics MSc + aerospace internships (Airbus / MAN) is a high-conviction deep-tech founder stack.
Cross-border mobility (Turkey → Germany → UK MSc → Germany again) is how non-EU founders break into the European deep-tech market.
